description: Dire Bear Form Level 60 Rank 2 55% of base mana Instant Requires Druid Requires level 40 Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 210, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 1560. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
name: Dire Bear Form
